paragraphs.text: Before bridges and tunnels were built, ferries carried millions of passengers across rivers and bays. In recent years, some cities have started new ferry services to reduce road traffic.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Ferries have an advantage in cities built around water: they need no new roads or rails, only piers where passengers can get on and off. Services can therefore be started quickly and at relatively low cost.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: However, ferries are slower than trains and often cannot run in bad weather. Their fuel use per passenger can also be high unless boats are full, so some operators are testing electric and hybrid vessels.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Passengers often say that they enjoy the journey itself. Surveys in one city found that commuters rated ferry trips as more relaxing than any other form of transport.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: In some cities, ferry tickets can be used on buses and trains as well, which makes it easier for commuters to combine different types of transport.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: some cities have started new ferry services to reduce road traffic

explanation.en: “to reduce road traffic” → traffic, letter G. C (bridges) and H (tunnels) are what came before, not the aim.
explanation.kk: «to reduce road traffic» → traffic, яғни G әрпі. Сол абзацтағы C (bridges) мен H (tunnels) — мақсат емес, бұрын салынған нәрселер.
explanation.ru: «to reduce road traffic» → traffic, буква G. C (bridges) и H (tunnels) из того же абзаца — то, что появилось раньше, а не цель.

items.quote: they need no new roads or rails, only piers where passengers can get on and off

explanation.en: “need no new roads or rails, only piers” → piers, letter E. “Require” = “need”.
explanation.kk: «need no new roads or rails, only piers» → piers, яғни E әрпі. «Require» = «need».
explanation.ru: «need no new roads or rails, only piers» → piers, буква E. «Require» = «need».

items.quote: often cannot run in bad weather

explanation.en: “often cannot run in bad weather” → weather, letter B.
explanation.kk: «often cannot run in bad weather» — жаман ауа райында жүре алмайды → weather, яғни B әрпі.
explanation.ru: «often cannot run in bad weather» → weather, буква B.

items.quote: Their fuel use per passenger can also be high unless boats are full

explanation.en: “fuel use per passenger can also be high unless boats are full” → full, letter A. F (expensive) sounds logical, but the condition is different.
explanation.kk: «fuel use per passenger can also be high unless boats are full» → full, яғни A әрпі. F (expensive) қисынды, бірақ мәтіндегі шарт басқа.
explanation.ru: «fuel use per passenger can also be high unless boats are full» → full, буква A. F (expensive) звучит логично, но в тексте условие другое.

items.quote: commuters rated ferry trips as more relaxing than any other form of transport

explanation.en: “rated ferry trips as more relaxing” → relaxing, letter D.
explanation.kk: «rated ferry trips as more relaxing» — паромды ең тыныш сапар деп бағалаған → relaxing, яғни D әрпі.
explanation.ru: «rated ferry trips as more relaxing» → relaxing, буква D.
